fact: Al-Watwan reports that the regulator Anrtic announced on 12 June 2025 a government ban, by ministerial circular signed 9 June 2025, on installing, testing, deploying or using Starlink satellite internet in Comoros, no authorisation having been granted to Starlink, with field checks to identify existing users (some subscribing from Madagascar or France).

Agence Ecofin reports that Starlink's official availability map lists Comoros among 16 African countries marked 'Starting in 2026' with no launch date, a status the map legend defines as coverage or regulatory authorisation pending, so Starlink service is not yet available there.
